title: System Protection Management Policy
definition: Maintain an Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) system to detect and alert malicious activity on the organization's computing systems, whether onsite or remote.

title: System Protection Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the organization's EDR system utilizes software agents that cannot be disabled by standard computing system users.

title: System Protection Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's EDR system is centrally managed and cloud-based.

title: System Protection Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the organization's EDR system's anti-malware signature is regularly updated on all computing systems.

title: System Protection Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's EDR system automatically scans removable media for potentially malicious files.

title: System Protection Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the organization's EDR system logs and tracks all running processes for cybersecurity incident response.

title: System Protection Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the organization's EDR system generates a database of the signatures (hashes) for all files on each of the organization's computing systems for cybersecurity incident response.

title: System Protection Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the organization's EDR system logs and alerts on appropriate events for cybersecurity incident response.

title: System Protection Management Policy
definition: Maintain host-based firewalls on each of the organization's computing systems.

title: System Protection Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's host-based firewalls are configured with a default rule to deny all network traffic.

title: System Protection Management Policy
definition: Maintain a whole-disk encryption system on the organization's endpoint computing systems.

title: System Protection Management Policy
definition: Maintain a host-based Data Loss Prevention (DLP) system on each organization's computing system.

title: System Protection Management Policy
definition: Maintain removable media safeguards on each of the organization's endpoint computing systems.

title: System Protection Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's removable media safeguard system creates an inventory of authorized storage and peripheral devices.

title: System Protection Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's removable media safeguard system tracks data owners on approved devices responsible for the media.

title: System Protection Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's removable media safeguard system disables removable storage media on computing systems that do not require such devices.

title: System Protection Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's removable media safeguard system disables unauthorized peripheral devices on computing systems that do not require such devices.

title: System Protection Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's removable media safeguard system only allows reading and writing on authorized removable media devices.

title: System Protection Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's removable media safeguard system only allows writing to authorized removable media devices utilizing encryption.
